claim: Try a ready-to-play photosynthesis game
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /?demo=1 and asserts Match up is playable

claim: Make six vocabulary games
sandbox: fresh demo context opens every mode, performs an interaction, and verifies three accepted 60-character terms also open every game

claim: Connect each word to its meaning
sandbox: fresh demo context matches a displayed word and meaning, then asserts the pair is confirmed

claim: Hit the right word before moving on
sandbox: fresh demo context chooses the displayed correct word and asserts the game confirms it

claim: Unscramble the word from its clue
sandbox: fresh demo context submits the answer to a displayed clue and asserts it advances

claim: Reveal letters without using six misses
sandbox: fresh demo context chooses a displayed correct letter and asserts it is revealed before six misses

claim: Find every hidden word-and-meaning pair
sandbox: fresh demo context finds one word-and-meaning pair and asserts it stays visible

claim: Answer up to five multiple-choice clues
sandbox: fresh demo context verifies five questions for six pairs and advances after a correct answer

claim: Free to use
sandbox: fresh demo context completes entry without a price, payment frame, or paywall

claim: No account
sandbox: fresh demo context reaches play without account fields

claim: There are no fields for student names or contact details
sandbox: fresh demo context traverses the maker and every game, then asserts form controls, storage, and requests contain no student-name or contact-data collection

claim: Games do not create student grades, records, or decisions
sandbox: fresh demo context opens every game and checks its controls, local storage, and network activity for the absence of gradebook, roster, record, or decision output

claim: Lists stay on this device
sandbox: fresh normal context types a title and three pairs, verifies app-written local storage survives reload, clears it through the UI, then verifies a recreated real draft survives the demo without any cross-origin request

claim: Use 3 to 30 pairs
sandbox: fresh demo context enters 31 pairs and asserts 30 are accepted with a precise limit message

claim: We check the list as you type
sandbox: fresh demo context enters an invalid line and asserts the announced parse error

claim: Copy a class link
sandbox: fresh demo context copies a link, asserts its data stays after #, and opens it in a fresh context

claim: Browsers do not send a class link's hash fragment to our web server
sandbox: fresh demo context copies a uniquely identifiable class link; a second fresh context records its navigation request, restores the list, and asserts the request URL and body omit the fragment and pair text

claim: A maximum 30-pair class link stays copyable and restores every pair
sandbox: fresh context creates a low-compressibility 30-pair list, copies its complete link, opens it in another context, and asserts the exact title and all 30 rows

claim: Download a lesson file that restores every pair
sandbox: fresh demo context downloads the sample lesson, imports it in a second fresh context, and asserts the exact sample rows return

claim: Lesson-file download and import stay in this browser until you choose where to send the file
sandbox: fresh demo context downloads and imports a uniquely identifiable lesson while recording action-time requests; it asserts the exact list returns with no extra network request or request body carrying the list

claim: Play games fullscreen
sandbox: fresh demo context invokes the browser fullscreen API from the labelled game control

claim: No advertising trackers, analytics scripts, or third-party runtime services
sandbox: fresh demo context records the complete sample flow and asserts all runtime requests, scripts, frames, and storage are first-party

claim: No cookies are used
sandbox: fresh demo context records every response header and asserts the browser cookie jar stays empty through the game flow

claim: Saved lists and opened game links still work offline
sandbox: fresh context creates a normal three-pair draft, copies and opens its game link online, then sets offline and proves the exact saved maker list and playable copied Match up route reload with no network request

claim: Reset restores the sample, and every demo exit deletes demo data without changing a real draft
where: demo banner, README, and demo documentation
sandbox: fresh context seeds real storage, uses browser Back from the one-click demo, then edits, resets, plays, and exits with Start for real; it asserts the real draft is exact and no demo key remains after each exit

claim: Run Wordlist Arcade with Node.js 20.19.x or Node.js 22.12+
where: README local-run instructions and package metadata
sandbox: the tagged unit check asserts the declared floors, then a clean installed dependency tree type-checks and builds with Node.js 20.19.0
